create_token_classification_evaluator: create a TokenClassificationEvaluator instance for evaluating NER models on token classification tasks
run_token_classification_compute: run token classification evaluation with a model, dataset, and seqeval metric to compute precision recall and f1 scores
prepare_token_classification_data: prepare token classification data by converting list-of-words columns to joined strings and extracting label references
process_token_classification_predictions: process pipeline predictions into per-word predicted labels aligned with original word boundaries
convert_words_to_offsets: convert a list of words into character start and end offsets for alignment with pipeline token predictions
